title: Capstone Api
summary: Master Capstone Api through explanation, prediction, implementation, and review.

challenges.title: Recall checkpoint
challenges.prompt: Without reopening the lesson, explain Capstone Api in your own words. Include the problem it solves, the core mechanism, and one boundary or failure.
challenges.hint: Use “Capstone Api” as a cue, then close the lesson again.

challenges.title: Prediction checkpoint
challenges.prompt: Choose one example or source file from this mission. Predict its behavior for a normal input and a changed or invalid input before running or revealing the reference. Explain the rule separating the outcomes.
challenges.hint: Change one condition at a time so the result teaches a rule.

challenges.title: Build and prove checkpoint
challenges.prompt: Implement, debug, or adapt the mission exercise yourself. Record the acceptance criterion, command or interaction used to verify it, failure evidence, and one tradeoff. Do not paste the reference solution.
challenges.hint: A passing check, measured result, focused diff, or reproducible demo is stronger than ‘done.’

openapi: 3.1.0
info:
  title: RelayBoard API
  version: 0.1.0
  description: >-
    Starting contract for the capstone. Evolve this file with the implementation;
    examples and integration tests should keep the two synchronized.
servers:
  - url: http://localhost:5000
    description: Local development
tags:
  - name: Session
  - name: Boards
  - name: Cards
  - name: Activity
paths:
  /api/session:
    post:
      tags: [Session]
      summary: Create an authenticated session
      operationId: createSession
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/Credentials'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Session created
          headers:
            Set-Cookie:
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/CurrentUser'
        '401':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Unauthorized'
    delete:
      tags: [Session]
      summary: Revoke the current session
      operationId: deleteSession
      security:
        - sessionCookie: []
      responses:
        '204':
          description: Session revoked
  /api/boards:
    get:
      tags: [Boards]
      summary: List boards visible to the current user
      operationId: listBoards
      security:
        - sessionCookie: []
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Visible boards
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/BoardSummary'
        '401':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Unauthorized'
    post:
      tags: [Boards]
      summary: Create a board exactly once for an idempotency key
      operationId: createBoard
      security:
        - sessionCookie: []
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/IdempotencyKey'
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/CreateBoard'
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Board created
          headers:
            Location:
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Board'
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/BadRequest'
        '401':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Unauthorized'
        '409':
          description: Idempotency key conflict
          content:
            application/problem+json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Problem'
  /api/boards/{boardId}:
    get:
      tags: [Boards]
      summary: Get a board and its active columns/cards
      operationId: getBoard
      security:
        - sessionCookie: []
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/BoardId'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Board visible to the current member
          headers:
            ETag:
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Board'
        '401':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Unauthorized'
        '404':
          description: Board absent or not visible
          content:
            application/problem+json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Problem'
  /api/boards/{boardId}/cards:
    post:
      tags: [Cards]
      summary: Create a card
      operationId: createCard
      security:
        - sessionCookie: []
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/BoardId'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/IdempotencyKey'
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/CreateCard'
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Card created
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Card'
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/BadRequest'
        '401':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Unauthorized'
        '404':
          description: Board or column absent or not visible
  /api/boards/{boardId}/cards/{cardId}:
    patch:
      tags: [Cards]
      summary: Edit or move a card using optimistic concurrency
      operationId: updateCard
      security:
        - sessionCookie: []
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/BoardId'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/CardId'
        - name: If-Match
          in: header
          required: true
          description: Version/ETag returned by the previous representation
          schema:
            type: string
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/UpdateCard'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Card updated
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Card'
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/BadRequest'
        '404':
          description: Card absent or not visible
        '412':
          description: Supplied version is stale
          content:
            application/problem+json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Problem'
  /api/boards/{boardId}/activity:
    get:
      tags: [Activity]
      summary: List board activity with stable cursor pagination
      operationId: listActivity
      security:
        - sessionCookie: []
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/BoardId'
        - name: cursor
          in: query
          schema:
            type: string
        - name: limit
          in: query
          schema:
            type: integer
            minimum: 1
            maximum: 100
            default: 20
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Activity page in descending creation order
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ActivityPage'
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/BadRequest'
        '404':
          description: Board absent or not visible
components:
  securitySchemes:
    sessionCookie:
      type: apiKey
      in: cookie
      name: relay_session
  parameters:
    BoardId:
      name: boardId
      in: path
      required: true
      schema:
        type: string
        format: uuid
    CardId:
      name: cardId
      in: path
      required: true
      schema:
        type: string
        format: uuid
    IdempotencyKey:
      name: Idempotency-Key
      in: header
      required: true
      schema:
        type: string
        minLength: 8
        maxLength: 200
  responses:
    BadRequest:
      description: Request validation failed
      content:
        application/problem+json:
          schema:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Problem'
    Unauthorized:
      description: Authentication is missing or invalid
      content:
        application/problem+json:
          schema:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Problem'
  schemas:
    Credentials:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required: [username, password]
      properties:
        username:
          type: string
          minLength: 2
          maxLength: 40
        password:
          type: string
          minLength: 12
          maxLength: 200
    CurrentUser:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required: [id, username]
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        username:
          type: string
    CreateBoard:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required: [name]
      properties:
        name:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 100
    BoardSummary:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required: [id, name, role, version]
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        name:
          type: string
        role:
          type: string
          enum: [owner, member]
        version:
          type: integer
          minimum: 0
    Board:
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/BoardSummary'
        - type: object
          required: [columns]
          properties:
            columns:
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Column'
    Column:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required: [id, name, position, cards]
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        name:
          type: string
        position:
          type: integer
          minimum: 0
        cards:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Card'
    CreateCard:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required: [columnId, title, clientOperationId]
      properties:
        columnId:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        title:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 200
        clientOperationId:
          type: string
          format: uuid
    UpdateCard:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      minProperties: 1
      properties:
        title:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 200
        columnId:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        position:
          type: integer
          minimum: 0
        archived:
          type: boolean
    Card:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required: [id, columnId, title, position, archived, version]
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        columnId:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        title:
          type: string
        position:
          type: integer
          minimum: 0
        archived:
          type: boolean
        version:
          type: integer
          minimum: 1
    Activity:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required: [id, version, type, createdAt, actorId]
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        version:
          type: integer
          minimum: 1
        type:
          type: string
        createdAt:
          type: string
          format: date-time
        actorId:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        data:
          type: object
          additionalProperties: true
    PageInfo:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required: [hasNextPage, nextCursor]
      properties:
        hasNextPage:
          type: boolean
        nextCursor:
          type: [string, 'null']
    ActivityPage:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required: [items, pageInfo]
      properties:
        items:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Activity'
        pageInfo:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/PageInfo'
    Problem:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: true
      required: [type, title, status]
      properties:
        type:
          type: string
          format: uri-reference
        title:
          type: string
        status:
          type: integer
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 599
        detail:
          type: string
        instance:
          type: string
          format: uri-reference
        errors:
          type: object
          additionalProperties:
            type: array
            items:
              type: string
